name: Intra Balance Type 3
definition: Intra-balance type used to specify pairs of from/to balances.

BalanceFrom.name: Balance From
BalanceFrom.definition: Balance from which the amount of money is moved.

BalanceTo.name: Balance To
BalanceTo.definition: Balance to which the amount of money is moved.

BalanceFromToRule.definition: The cash balance type of BalanceFrom must be different from the cash balance type of BalanceTo.
